method.mergeCommitHelp: Keeps every commit and adds a merge commit.
method.squashHelp: Combines the changes into one new commit.
method.fastForwardHelp: Moves the target to the last commit. Only when the target has not moved on.

merge.deleteSource: Delete the source branch {{source}} after the merge
merge.failed: The merge failed. Tell an administrator with the request ID.
merge.stillRunning: Still processing. It continues even if you leave this page.

source.keptRefused: The source branch was kept: you may not delete it.
source.keptMoved: The source branch was kept: it has new commits.
source.keptFailed: The source branch was kept: it could not be deleted.

superseded.conflict: It now conflicts with the target. Push a fix, then merge again.

superseded.methodNotAllowed: That merge method is no longer allowed. Choose another one and merge again.
